# WELD

> WELD is the front page of the Wayne State developer stack: one Laravel + Inertia/Vue app with every part already joined. Clone it, rename it, deploy it.

**W**ired, **E**verything, **L**inked, **D**eployed. Many parts, one piece.

WELD is the whole Wayne State app stack joined into one application. Install it, deploy it, and every part is already
hooked up: sign-in, security headers, checks, coding standards, CI and the WayneUI interface. Think of it as the
Megazord, except it comes with a deploy script and nobody has to shout to make it combine.

Development happens on Wayne State's GitLab; this repository is a release mirror. Changes land there first.

Every page below is Markdown. The HTML pages send the same Markdown to a client that asks for `text/markdown`. Written by Squire's agent-ready kit from the README and the pages; do not edit.

## Pages

- [WELD: Many parts, one piece.](https://weld.apps.wayne.edu/index.md): WELD is the front page of the Wayne State developer stack: one Laravel + Inertia/Vue app with every part already joined. Clone it, rename it, deploy it.

## Prompts

- [Get started with WELD](https://weld.apps.wayne.edu/#prompt-get-started): Clone it, bring it up in Docker, run the doctor and the gate, and plan the rename that makes it yours. The prompt itself is in https://weld.apps.wayne.edu/index.md.
- [Add a signed-in page to a WELD app](https://weld.apps.wayne.edu/#prompt-add-page): One route behind SESAME, one Vue page in the app's layout, one test, and the gate run green. The prompt itself is in https://weld.apps.wayne.edu/index.md.
